title: Living Campaign, GM Workspace & Session Intelligence
objective: Deliver a living campaign operating workspace for party/NPC/plot/adventure/session preparation, quests/projects, clues, notes, handouts, current state, return summaries and GM controls by composing existing APW/APM, Adventure/Project, Character, Scene, Investigation, ISE and SSA owners rather than creating a parallel campaign ledger.

bounded_contract.canonical_owner_contract: APW/APM, Adventure/Project, Character, Scene, Investigation, ISE, SSA, Event/time and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative. WCI-04 composes stable references and cannot mint a second party, NPC, plot, quest/project, clue, Scene, investigation, session or campaign ledger.
bounded_contract.workspace_contract: The living campaign workspace may project authorized party/NPC/plot/adventure/session preparation, quest/project, clue, note, handout, current-state, return-summary, prepared-Scene and spatial references with stable provenance; presentation grouping is not canonical state.
bounded_contract.proposal_mutation_contract: Consequential changes are proposal-only. WCI-04 may form versioned, idempotent owner-operation proposals carrying canonical owner reference, expected owner version, operation kind and evidence, but the owning APW/APM, Adventure/Project, Scene, Investigation or other canonical domain must authorize and commit any mutation.
bounded_contract.session_intelligence_contract: Session summaries, return summaries and GM intelligence are projections over authorized committed evidence. They cannot silently advance campaign time, choose meaningful player actions, reveal GM state, fabricate owner results or infer uncommitted outcomes.
bounded_contract.visibility_contract: Authorization and visibility filtering precede counts, summaries, party/NPC/plot state, clue/handout projection, return summaries, player/reader views and AI context; GM-only/private content and protected cardinality cannot leak through aggregate output.
bounded_contract.accessibility_contract: Consequential campaign/session information requires accessible nonvisual summaries/equivalents; boards, graphs, maps and prepared-Scene visuals are not exclusive truth.
bounded_contract.determinism_contract: Equivalent authorized inputs produce stable ordering, projections and deterministic receipts independent of view/platform; wall-clock timing, layout and canvas position are not semantic truth.
bounded_contract.persistence_decision: No durable WCI-04 persistence is required for this tranche; existing canonical owner persistence remains authoritative and migration 0022 remains unreserved.
bounded_contract.successor_boundary: WCI-05+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

acceptance_contract: Test-first RED proves the bounded WCI-04 campaign/session workspace contract and panel do not exist before production implementation.

One living campaign workspace composes authorized stable APW/APM, Adventure/Project, Character, Scene, Investigation, ISE, SSA and Event/time references without creating a parallel campaign/session ledger.
GM/private clues, notes, handouts, NPC/plot state and protected cardinality are filtered before counts, summaries, player/reader projections and AI context.
Prepared-Scene and spatial references remain presentation/projection references rather than new Scene or spatial owner truth.
Return/session intelligence is derived only from authorized committed evidence and cannot silently advance campaign time, choose player actions, reveal GM state or fabricate owner outcomes.
Consequential changes produce versioned/idempotent owner-operation proposals only; WCI-04 performs no canonical owner mutation.
Consequential campaign/session results have accessible nonvisual equivalents and deterministic ordering/receipts independent of input order.
No durable WCI-04 persistence, migration 0022, public publishing, provider activation or WCI-05 ownership is introduced.
Final validation uses exactly one WCI-04 current-family profile, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparator with zero historical predecessor fanout.
preserved_boundaries: WCI-03 remains completed_verified with retired implementation authority.
APW/APM, Adventure/Project, Character, Scene, Investigation, ISE, SSA, Event/time and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.
APW campaign-activity orchestration does not own authoritative gameplay effects; owning domains remain external.
APM mini-campaign routing keeps Adventure graph/run authority external and requires fresh owner state before transitions.
No second campaign/session/quest/clue/Scene/investigation ledger or automatic canonical mutation is authorized.
No durable WCI-04 ledger or migration 0022 is introduced.
WCI-05+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
